questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy under review, the 'Climate Change Adaptation Action Plan 2013-2025', clearly identifies climate action as its core purpose. The policy is designed to help the Benalla Rural City Council adapt to future changes in climate, and it uses a risk management approach to address the uncertainty inherent to climate predictions. The policy focuses on all areas of Council business across the Benalla Rural City, and it includes a number of actions that focus on the community, as community resilience and sustainability are fundamental to the Council’s role. The policy also includes specific actions related to climate change, such as the incorporation of climate change considerations into current reporting arrangements, and the requirement for staff to report on how climate change risk has been addressed in annual reports and performance reviews.

quote.content: This Action Plan will assist Council to make the necessary changes it needs to make to adequately prepare for the impacts of a changing climate. This project seeks to develop an Action Plan that will help the Benalla Rural City Council to adapt to future changes in climate.

It also mentions the incorporation of climate change considerations into all future strategic planning and reporting. The document also discusses the need for the local government to include climate change considerations in their key documents as they come up for review. Furthermore, the document suggests that climate change impacts almost every area of Council business, indicating a broad recognition of the need for action on climate change.

quote.content: Actions 8.1 and 8.2 support the mainstreaming of climate change into all Council business through the incorporation of climate change considerations into current reporting arrangements. In addition, Council will include consideration of climate change risks, where relevant, in all future strategic planning and reporting.
